about: Trust notes for each test run, written by hand after looking at its graphs. combine_usage.py copies them into container-usage.json. trust is one of: good, caveats, low.
all_runs: Each size has only one test run, so how much its numbers would vary between runs is unknown.

3-node-aro-hcp.notes: Memory is complete, but only 74% of CPU readings exist, so its CPU numbers, especially peaks, are less reliable. Runs a newer OpenShift (4.20) than most runs (4.19).

6-node-aro-hcp.notes: Only 72% of CPU readings exist and a few memory readings are missing, so its CPU numbers, especially peaks, are less reliable. Runs a newer OpenShift (4.20) than most runs (4.19).

12-nodes-100-client-qps-rate-aro-hcp.notes: Complete data. Uses about 2 GiB more memory than the other 12-node run, mostly kube-apiserver.

49-node-hcp-raw.notes: Complete data, but a different setup from the other runs: a newer OpenShift (4.22, most runs are 4.19) and the only run with a router. Uses more memory than the 60-node run.

250-node-aro-hcp.notes: Complete once its duplicate records are removed, which the scripts do.

500-node-aro-hcp.notes: No churn phase, so the run never settles: memory comes from its last 10 minutes and CPU from the whole run, as a conservative (high) estimate. Its duplicate records are removed by the scripts.
